title: Variational form of the profiled objective
statement: S_psi^+(I_q) = min_B Var(E[S_psi - B S_lam | Z]) (Loewner minimum, attained exactly at solutions of B I_ll = I_pl), extending the profiled objective to singular nuisance blocks; yields refinement monotonicity with an exact neutrality characterization for splits (any d_psi; audited), the wasted-cell/global-tie phenomena, and a one-line re-derivation of efficient-score domination with its exact gap. The core identity is the classical extremal characterization of the generalized Schur complement (Krein 1947; Anderson 1971; Li-Mathias 2000, Thm 2.2).
assumptions: binned information matrix PSD (sufficient for the matrix identity)
centered scores (E[S]=0) for the Var(E[.|Z]) statistical reading
K->infty gap vanishing additionally requires a nonsingular full nuisance block (the pseudo-inverse map is discontinuous at rank drops)
consequence (c) neutrality requires the merged configuration to be entirely nuisance-degenerate

proof_location.section: DS11. Variational form of the profiled objective

warning: The pseudo-inverse extension at singular nuisance blocks leaves the in-bin statistical formulation (DS9): it can strictly exceed the feasible in-bin optimum (see CE-DS-DEGENERATE-GLOBAL-TIE-001).
